# Copilot instructions

The working agreement for this repository lives in
[`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md). Read it before changing code, tests, art, or docs.

Most important:

- `npm run verify` is the pre-PR definition of done.
- The invariants in `AGENTS.md` are deliberate and must not be weakened silently.
- The audience is a two-year-old who cannot read; choose the forgiving option.

Do not duplicate rules here. Keep `AGENTS.md` as the single home.
